items.exampleEn: The company plans to modernize its old factories.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司計畫將老舊的工廠現代化。

items.exampleEn: He was a mediocre student but became a great writer.
items.exampleZh: 他曾是個成績平平的學生，後來卻成為偉大的作家。

items.exampleEn: A morning flight is preferable because the airport is less crowded.
items.exampleZh: 早上的班機比較好，因為機場比較不擠。

items.exampleEn: She delicately lifted the baby bird and put it back on the branch.
items.exampleZh: 她小心翼翼地捧起那隻雛鳥，把牠放回樹枝上。

items.exampleEn: The bumper of this new car is made of soft plastic.
items.exampleZh: 這輛新車的保險桿是用軟塑膠做的。

items.exampleEn: The deer in the park are so tame that they eat from your hand.
items.exampleZh: 公園裡的鹿非常溫馴，會直接從你手上吃東西。

items.exampleEn: The river flows powerfully after heavy rain.
items.exampleZh: 大雨過後，河水奔流得很猛烈。

items.exampleEn: He wore a shabby old coat with holes in the sleeves.
items.exampleZh: 他穿著一件破舊的大衣，袖子還有破洞。

items.sentenceEn: The farmers had a bumper crop of apples this year.
items.sentenceZh: 今年農夫們的蘋果大豐收。

items.audioEn: The hotel looked shabby from the outside, but the rooms were clean and comfortable.
items.audioZh: 那間飯店從外面看很破舊，但房間乾淨又舒適。

items.sentenceEn: Some people find a quiet evening at home preferable to a big party.
items.sentenceZh: 有些人覺得在家度過安靜的夜晚比參加大型派對好。

items.sentenceEn: Our school finally modernized its computer room last summer.
items.sentenceZh: 我們學校去年夏天終於把電腦教室現代化了。

items.stemEn: The movie was ____; it wasn't terrible, but I'll forget it soon.
items.stemZh: 那部電影很普通，不算糟糕，但我很快就會忘記。

items.stemEn: Someone hit the back ____ of my car in the parking lot.
items.stemZh: 有人在停車場撞到我車子的後保險桿。

items.passageEn: My favorite cafe used to look shabby, with old chairs and a broken sign. Last year, the new owner decided to modernize it. Now the walls are white, and the cakes are delicately decorated with fresh fruit. Some customers say the coffee is still mediocre, but the room feels bright and cozy. There is even a tame old cat that sleeps by the window. On weekends, a guitarist plays and sings there, and his voice fills the room powerfully.
items.passageZh: 我最喜歡的咖啡館以前看起來很破舊，椅子很舊，招牌也壞了。去年，新老闆決定把它現代化。現在牆壁是白色的，蛋糕上精緻地裝飾著新鮮水果。有些客人說咖啡還是普普通通，但店裡感覺明亮又溫馨。甚至還有一隻溫馴的老貓睡在窗邊。週末有一位吉他手在那裡自彈自唱，他的歌聲渾厚有力地充滿整個空間。

questions.questionZh: 有些客人對咖啡的評價是什麼？

items.promptZh: 對這麼短的距離來說，走路比開車好。
referenceEn: For such a short distance, walking is preferable to driving.
Walking is preferable to driving for such a short trip.
rubricZh: 要用 preferable to（例如 walking is preferable to driving）
preferable to 後面接名詞或動名詞，例如 driving 等
「這麼短的距離」可寫，例如 such a short distance、such a short trip 等

items.promptZh: 他們搬進了一間破舊的小公寓。
referenceEn: They moved into a shabby little apartment.
They moved into a small, shabby apartment.
rubricZh: shabby 表示「破舊的」（例如 a shabby little apartment 等）；形容詞順序不扣分
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 moved、have moved 等）
